responsibility: This header declares the RTL-specific extensions to GCC’s selftest framework. It provides macros and functions for asserting dumped RTL text, structural equality, and pointer equality, plus the rtl_dump_test RAII class for loading RTL function dumps and helpers such as get_insn_by_uid and CFG verifiers used by RTL selftests.
same_name_distinction: This .h file exposes the RTL selftest interface—macros, assertion declarations, rtl_dump_test, and helper prototypes—while gcc/selftest-rtl.cc contains the concrete assertion logic, dump-loading setup/cleanup, and UID search implementation.
